Title: Attempt to create an order with missing required customer gender field
Preconditions: User is logged in as a shop owner or worker with order creation permissions
Steps:
1. Navigate to the 'Create New Order' screen. 2. Fill in all required fields except 'Customer Gender'. 3. Enter valid values for all other fields (e.g., customer name, phone, delivery date, trial date). 4. Click the 'Create Order' button.

Test Data: Customer Name: John Doe, Customer Phone: 01712345678, Delivery Date: 2025-12-31, Trial Date: 2025-12-20, Order Items: 1 Shirt
Expected Result: The system displays an error message indicating that the 'Customer Gender' field is required. The order is not created.

Title: Verify that order financial details (total, paid, due amounts) are not exposed to unauthorized users
Preconditions: User A (shop owner) has an existing order with financial details recorded. User B (shop worker) has access to the system but is not associated with User A's shop.
Steps:
1. Log in as User B (shop worker). 2. Navigate to the order listing page. 3. Attempt to view the order details for User A's order by manually entering the order ID in the URL or via direct API call if accessible through UI actions (e.g., inspecting network requests). 4. Observe the order details displayed or returned.

Test Data: Order ID: 12345 (belonging to User A's shop)
Expected Result: The order details screen displays a generic error message (e.g., 'Access denied' or 'Order not found'). No financial details (total amount, paid amount, due amount) are visible or returned in the response.

Test Data: Paid amount: 3000 (updated from 2000)
Expected Result: The order details screen shows the updated paid amount as 3000, due amount as 2000, and total amount remains unchanged at 5000.

Title: Verify that negative or non-numeric values for financial fields (paid amount, total amount) are rejected during order update
Section: Order Management - Input Validation for Financial Data
Preconditions: User has an existing order and access to update the order.
Steps:
